items.title: St. Paul Park refinery sold as part of $4.2B deal
items.summary: Marathon Petroleum is selling oil refineries in St. Paul Park and Mandan, N.D., along with Marathon’s related marketing business, in a deal valued at $4.2 billion. Sugarland, Texas-based CVR Energy Inc., is the buyer. “We are thrilled to deliver on our plan to strategically grow and diversify our business,” Dane Neumann, president and CEO of CVR Energy, said in a statement, adding that the ...
